title: Keys on Fragments need the long form

slides.text: A Fragment in a list needs a key 🔑
slides.say: Mapping a list where each item is a Fragment? Then the Fragment needs a key.

slides.code:
// 🔴 can't put a key here posts.map(post => <>

{post.title}

{post.body}

)
slides.say: The short empty tag syntax cannot take a key. There is nowhere to write it.
So import Fragment from react, write it out in full, and give it the key.

slides.text: Still no wrapper in the DOM. Just a key React can track.
slides.say: You still get no wrapper element in the page. Only a key that React uses to track each item.
